title: satin pillow sham covers
text: satin pillow sham covers. These pillow shams are a bit too shiny for me.  I was focused on zippered shams, and these are - but they are also 'satin.'  Eh.  Too slippery and shiny.  A medium/dark gray.  I will probably share these will someone who likes shiny satin.  They did machine wash and dry nicely.
